description: The controller has not adhered to approved codes of conduct or certification mechanisms, or lacks documented data protection policies as required by Article 24.2. This includes failure to maintain evidence of compliance measures and policy adherence.
applicability: Applicable to all data controllers, particularly those using codes of conduct or certification as compliance mechanisms. Includes requirements for documented policies, procedures, and evidence of their implementation.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of policy documentation, certification records, code of conduct adherence, and compliance evidence. Requires verification that documented policies exist and are followed.
